text:
alex: Heads-up — opening a short thread on a TF plan to roll out a mixed preemptible+on-demand pool for gpu-worker autoscaling. Goal: reduce unit cost without regressing latency SLOs.

maria: +1. Can you paste the planned changes? curious how interruption handling will be wired.

alex: Pasting the core module changes we intend to land (simplified):
```
module "gpu_pool" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@…/infra/modules/gpu-pool.git?ref=rev"
  capacity = {
    on_demand   = 4
    preemptible = 12
    mix_strategy = "capacity_optimized"
  }
  launch_template = var.launch_template_id
  tags = merge(var.common_tags, { "env": "prod", "pool": "gpu-mix-v2" })
}
```

sam: For instance families, we should broaden the candidate set so AWS can find capacity: p4d/p3dn/p3/g5/g4dn. Add weighted capacity so 1 p4d ~ 8 g4dn etc. Also add fallback to smaller GPUs if large ones are scarce.

jin: Interruption handling plan: lifecycle hook on the autoscaling group + a node daemonset that watches the metadata/IMDS termination notice and drains pods. Recommend spot-interruptor v0.6 + our node-termination-handler config:
```
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: DaemonSet
metadata:
  name: node-termination-handler
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ntd
        image: public/spot-interruptor:0.6
        args: ["--drain-timeout=20s"]
```
We must also export the termination event to metrics for alerting.

alex: Rollout plan for TF: 
- create a new launch template version (ami rotation + ENA enhanced networking enabled)
- update ASG with weighted capacities and target_capacity = 20 but split across mix pools
- apply first to canary subpool (az-a, max 2 nodes)
- observe 4h canary window, then promote if no regressions
- enable termination-drain-latency alert to 30s

maria: Metrics to track during canary: pod evictions, average node startup time, queue length for inference, model load time, and SLO p50/p95 latency. Also watch cost burn per hour for the pool. Add tag `spot:lifecycle=preemptible` to all spot instances so billing pipelines can slice it out.

sam: Small operational note: ensure kernel/nvidia drivers match across AMIs. Bake AMIs with nvidia-driver 535 and cuDNN X, so mixed families don't break runtime. Also ensure docker runtime and nvidia-container-runtime versions are pinned.

ci-bot: terraform plan finished: https://ci.internal/plan/789 — plan shows: new launch_template version, change to asg desired / weighted_capacity, new IAM role for interrupt handler, extra tags.

alex: I'll open the PR with the TF changes + the daemonset manifest. Looking for approvers @maria @sam. Targeting deploy tomorrow if no objections :thumbsup:.

maria: lgtm from me. keep canary at 4 hours and manual promote.

sam: lgtm. add a region quota pre-check — eu-west-1 has limited p4 quotas and we've hit it before.

jin: I'll prepare a short runbook for node-termination incidents and update the incident playbook with the new drain timings.

alex: thanks all — PR link once created.
